item.title: Exactly solvable model reveals how trapped light can create magnetic order in one-dimensional spin chains
item.description:
📚 Physics News
A research team wanted to better understand how the forces between particles inside a material change. Their work provides the simplest exactly solvable examples showing that light can create new phase transitions with materials.

In the strong coupling regime, the device reveals a clean superconducting gap, where robust and non-robust ZBPs are observed in distinct magnetic field ranges. Conversely, increasing the gate voltage drives the system toward the weak coupling regime, where the gap becomes narrow and soft. Consequently, robust ZBPs disappear while non-robust ones persist.
